test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the numbers from among the given options that would be most appropriate for replacing the question mark (?).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17dec0e449c4738df2925d491aa7976a69b7a0d6817af8c84f5f39dafbb0e81d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

**In each figure 2 is placed in first square and the product of both the numbers in square is placed in circle.**

In figure 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fed391e584e8dc75cb91cad21d1d30c24c040b6a6f4ab5b10c979e681c1e125b.png] 

2 × 6 = 12;

In figure 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cd2b4f1d4e1c9e9391b19f1922e4a95ce6de180e773b1d3e8b5aa303752158e.png] 

2 × 8 = 16

Similarly, in figure 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9139be334eff783ca835d09ea9987e59c7c3b4425bd425b4ed8990b400711c7.png] 

**2 × 10 = 20**

Hence, both the question marks will be replaced by 2 and 10 respectively from left to right.
